POPULATION_BOUND_2026_08_13.READ_THIS_BEFORE_APPLYING_R5: every correlation in abs_spearman below is a Spearman computed ACROSS THE SIX FAMILIES in census_families, and over nothing else. The ceiling of 0.80 and the over_ceiling_pairs derived from it are therefore statements about how these axes co-move ON THAT POPULATION.
POPULATION_BOUND_2026_08_13.the_rule: applying R5 to a family outside census_families is an EXTRAPOLATION and must be DECLARED as one at the point of use. It is not forbidden — it may well hold — but an undeclared extrapolation reports a verdict the matrix did not earn.
POPULATION_BOUND_2026_08_13.why_this_was_added: at b92521f the R5 constraint was applied to MARBLED, GLITTER and BAKED — all three absent from this census — and produced three FAIL verdicts. Corrected to NEITHER at d5i_adjudication_correction.json. The record carried its census_families all along and nothing stopped a later reader applying it outside them; this makes the bound impossible to miss rather than merely available.
